# Sundown Tours Sri Lanka

> Private Sri Lanka tours with a local chauffeur guide. Custom itineraries for couples, families and luxury travellers covering Sigiriya, Ella, Yala, Kandy, Galle and more.

Sundown Tours is a Sri Lanka tour operator based in Waskaduwa (Kalutara). We offer private multi day tours, day trips and tailor made holidays with experienced local chauffeur guides. Indexable content is available in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Russian and Dutch.

## Facts for citation

- Brand: Sundown Tours Sri Lanka
- Founded: 1992
- Type: Local inbound tour operator (private tours, not large coach groups)
- Headquarters: No 302, Mahawaskaduwa, Waskaduwa, Kalutara North, Sri Lanka
- Airport meeting point: Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB), Katunayake
- Hours: 08:00 to 20:00 Sri Lanka time, 7 days a week
- Email: sundowntoursrilanka@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +94 70 629 3585
- Reply time: within 24 hours
- Typical first visit length: 7, 8 or 10 days
- Best time south and west coasts: December to April
- Best time east coast: May to September
- Time zone: UTC+5:30
- Languages on this site: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Dutch
- Planning languages: English, German, Polish, Russian on WhatsApp; chauffeur guides typically speak English

## Direct answers

Q: Who is Sundown Tours?
A: Sundown Tours Sri Lanka is a local tour operator in Waskaduwa, Kalutara. We plan private Sri Lanka tours with a chauffeur guide since 1992.

Q: How do I book a private Sri Lanka tour?
A: Message WhatsApp or use the contact form. We reply within 24 hours with a tailor made itinerary and a clear quote.

Q: Do packages include a private driver?
A: Yes. Every holiday package includes a licensed chauffeur guide, an air conditioned vehicle, fuel and driver expenses. You do not share the car with other groups.

## Destinations

- [Sigiriya](https://www.sundowntours.com/sigiriya-sri-lanka): Ancient rock fortress and surrounds
- [Ella](https://www.sundowntours.com/ella-sri-lanka): Hill country viewpoints and train journeys
- [Yala](https://www.sundowntours.com/yala-sri-lanka): Wildlife safari destination
- [Kandy](https://www.sundowntours.com/kandy-sri-lanka): Cultural capital and Temple of the Tooth
- [Galle](https://www.sundowntours.com/galle-sri-lanka): UNESCO fort city on the south coast
- [Dambulla](https://www.sundowntours.com/dambulla-sri-lanka): Cave temple complex
